This 2025 Nissan Altima 2.5 SV in gray delivers the reliability and efficiency you need for everyday driving, backed by a 2.5L 4-Cylinder DOHC 16V engine that achieves 27 city and 39 highway MPG.

- AM/FM radio with SiriusXM
- NissanConnect featuring Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Power driver seat
- Fully automatic headlights

The Altima provides a comfortable driving experience with its front bucket seats and cloth trim, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel ensures every driver finds their ideal position. You'll appreciate the convenience of fully automatic headlights and speed-sensitive wipers that adjust to weather conditions. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work together to maintain vehicle stability in various driving conditions, while four-wheel independent suspension and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power and smooth handling.

Technology keeps you connected with NissanConnect and compatibility for both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing seamless integration with your smartphone. The AM/FM audio system with SiriusXM means entertainment options are at your fingertips, and steering wheel mounted controls let you manage audio without taking your hands off the wheel.

Practical features demonstrate thoughtful design: dual trunk hooks secure your cargo, floor mats protect your interior, and a hideaway net keeps smaller items organized. The rear seat center armrest and split folding rear seat provide flexibility for passengers and cargo alike, while the trip computer and outside temperature display offer useful driving information.

This Altima combines efficient performance with dependable features that make sedan ownership straightforward and satisfying. We invite you to visit our showroom to see this vehicle in person and experience the comfort and capability it offers.

Discover the 2024 Hyundai IONIQ 5 Limited, a sophisticated electric vehicle that combines innovative design with practical everyday functionality for the modern driver. The Digital Teal is the most sought after color, come see it while it's still available.

- 132 MPGe city / 98 MPGe highway efficiency
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay & Android Auto integration
- Heads-Up Display for enhanced driving awareness
- Heated & Ventilated Front Bucket Seats with memory positioning
- Dual zone automatic climate control
- Power Liftgate for convenient cargo access
- 8-speaker AM/FM/SiriusXM/HD Display Audio System
- Heated steering wheel for winter comfort
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Rain sensing wipers and fully automatic headlights
- Electronic Stability Control and four-wheel independent suspension
- 4-wheel disc brakes with brake assist
- 19-inch aero alloy wheels
- Bluelink+ emergency communication system
- Leather steering wheel with steering wheel mounted audio controls

This green Limited model combines efficiency with comfort through its electric powertrain and thoughtfully designed interior. The heated and ventilated front seats adjust to memory settings, while the dual-zone climate system ensures both driver and passenger comfort regardless of the season. Dual front side impact airbags, occupant sensing airbags, and an overhead airbag system provide comprehensive protection for all occupants.

The vehicle's advanced technology features create a connected driving experience. The navigation system works seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you informed and in control. The heads-up display projects critical driving information directly into your line of sight, reducing distractions while maintaining awareness of road conditions and speed.

Smart features enhance daily convenience and vehicle operation. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during nighttime driving, while the HomeLink transmitter integrates garage door operation into your vehicle's systems. Fully automatic headlights activate when needed, and rain-sensing wipers respond to weather conditions automatically. The heated steering wheel and heated door mirrors provide comfort during cold weather months.

The IONIQ 5 Limited delivers responsive handling and reliable braking performance. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering creates a balanced driving experience, while the four-wheel disc brake system with brake assist ensures confident stopping power in various conditions. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain vehicle composure in challenging driving situations.

This electric vehicle comes equipped with practical storage solutions and safety features designed for everyday use. The power liftgate simplifies cargo loading, while the split-folding rear seat expands interior space for larger items. A first aid kit, cargo net, and vehicle-to-load adapter are included to support your needs on every journey.

Contact us today to experience the 2024 Hyundai IONIQ 5 Limited and discover how its innovative technology and efficient performance can enhance your daily driving while supporting your commitment to sustainable transportation.

The Rogue SV is loaded with advanced safety and technology features that elevate your driving adventures. One standout feature is **Smart device mirroring**, which allows you to seamlessly integrate your smartphone with the vehicles infotainment system. This functionality enables you to access navigation and entertainment options without taking your eyes off the road, enhancing safety and convenience.

Another remarkable attribute is the **Hands-on steering assist/lane centering** system. This feature acts as your ultimate co-pilot, maintaining a safe distance from other vehicles and ensuring you stay centered in your lane. Perfect for long trips, it significantly reduces the stress of speed and lane management.

Safety is paramount in the Rogue SV, highlighted by its **Forward collision mitigation** system. This proactive technology activates when it detects an impending collision, deploying safeguards to prevent or minimize impact severity. Complementing this is the **Front pedestrian impact prevention** system, which constantly monitors the road for pedestrians, enabling the vehicle to take necessary actions to avert collisions.

For those needing connectivity on the go, the **Mobile hotspot** feature turns the Rogue SV into a Wi-Fi hotspot, allowing passengers to connect their devices without using personal data. Additionally, the **Rear camera** provides enhanced visibility of obstacles behind the vehicle, making parking and reversing safer.

The vehicle further includes **Lane departure prevention** technology, alerting you if you unintentionally drift out of your lane, and an **Active blind spot system** that prevents unsafe lane changes by alerting you to vehicles in your blind spots. The **Rear collision mitigation** system also prepares for potential rear-end collisions, ensuring comprehensive safety.

Finally, the **Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go** function simplifies driving in traffic, automatically adjusting your speed to match the flow around you.

In summary, the 2022 Nissan Rogue SV FWD combines safety, technology, and performance in an unbeatable package. With its recent price drop, now is the ideal time to experience this exceptional vehicle and elevate your driving experience. Dont miss out!

description: Selling a 2003 Toyota Land Cruiser (100 series). Purchased from King's Chariot in 2021 for $22k with electrical issues that were not disclosed. I am a person who places a very high value on integrity and am not looking to pass along my woes to the next patsy. The Bad: Electrical issues. Rear running lights do not work (brake lights are unaffected), high beams do not work, dash lighting does not work. Headlights work but seem dim. No dash lighting means no idea what the gauges are displaying in the dark. Something is drawing on the battery when the vehicle is off. I keep the battery disconnected for this reason. Wheels were not balanced. At high-speed this thing shakes. Noticed there are no weights attached to the wheels most likely the culprit. Interior looks like it has 300k miles and a quarter century of wear & tear  because it does. Driver seat is torn in the usual place, and the steering wheel needs to be rewrapped. Tape deck does not work (sorry 70s/'80s kids!) but radio, CD player, etc. does. Lock actuators are going out and sometimes don't work on all doors. Sometimes, have to individually lock/unlock (may be related to electrical, not sure). Throwing a P0420 code. Had it looked at  catalytic converters need to be replaced. I may have missed something you consider important  I'm not a mechanic, and I am also not trying to be intentionally misleading or dishonest. If I know about it, I have listed it above. The Good: Motor, transmission, frame, and body are in excellent condition. Dobinsons lifted suspension, Icon Vector 5 wheels, ARB compressor, ARB lights are legit equipment that look great and function even better. Heated seats, seat adjustment controls, HVAC controls, electric adjustable mirrors, antenna motor, all work Third row seats are removed but included with the sale; super easy to re-install/remove. This is a project vehicle. Perfect for the professional mechanic or restoration specialist. I have the title in hand and ready for transfer.

Be sure to take note of all this vehicle has to offer: No Accidents! Important/Valuable Packages & Equipment Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you. Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road. This Durango GT Plus represents a practical choice for families seeking space, comfort, and modern conveniences. We invite you to examine it in person and take it for a test drive to experience its capability and refinement firsthand.

This 2019 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 RST delivers the capability and comfort you need in a full-size truck built to handle any job or adventure.

- Integrated Trailer Brake Controller
- Z71 Off-Road and Protection Package with Hill Descent Control
- Convenience Package with bucket seats, heated seats, and heated steering wheel

- LED fog lamps and HD rear vision camera
- Universal Home Remote

- Trailering package with hitch guidance
- Bed-mounted LED cargo lighting

Finished in white with an attractive body-color grille and high-gloss black mirror caps, this RST presents a refined appearance while maintaining the rugged character you expect from a Silverado. The 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 produces 355 horsepower and 383 pound-feet of torque, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD to deliver dependable performance whether you're towing, hauling, or navigating challenging terrain.

The cabin combines practicality with thoughtful amenities. Comfortable front bucket seats with 10-way power adjustment and lumbar support sit beneath a leather-wrapped steering wheel that can be heated for cold mornings. Dual-zone automatic climate control keeps you and your passenger comfortable in any season, while the heated seats add extra warmth when needed. The center console provides convenient storage and organization for your essentials.

Technology keeps you connected and informed. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system features an 8-inch touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, USB ports throughout the cabin, and SiriusXM Radio with HD Radio capability. The proven 6.2L EcoTec3 V8 delivers outstanding horsepower, impressive towing capability, and smooth acceleration while the 2-speed Active Electronic AutoTrac 4WD system provides confidence in changing road and weather conditions. Finished in elegant Dark Ash Metallic, the High Country stands apart with distinctive chrome exterior accents, LED daytime running lamps, dual exhaust system, panoramic sunroof, premium styling, and bold body lines that create a commanding presence wherever you travel.

Whether you're towing the family boat, taking a cross-country vacation, or simply enjoying the luxury of a premium full-size SUV, this 2022 Chevrolet Suburban High Country delivers unmatched comfort, capability, and advanced technology in one exceptional package.
